concepts.def: Thylakoid membrane; photosystems II and I split water, produce ATP via chemiosmosis and NADPH.
Stromal carbon fixation: RuBisCO joins CO2 to RuBP (Calvin & Benson 1948-50 using carbon-14).
ATP synthesis driven by proton gradient across membrane (Mitchell 1961 chemiosmotic hypothesis).
Cytoplasmic conversion of glucose to two pyruvate, net 2 ATP and 2 NADH.
Mitochondrial matrix oxidation of acetyl-CoA producing CO2, NADH, FADH2, ATP (Krebs 1937).
Inner mitochondrial membrane; electrons pass through complexes I-IV pumping H+; O2 final acceptor.

Metabolism & Respiration brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.
